# P12 Genus synthesis on C2 (v2 = tag rtl-v2-final, v3 = branch rtl-v3). Technology: a commercial 28nm FD-SOI standard-cell library, typical corner; area in library units.
Pre-layout: no LEF, library default wireload; power is vectorless (default switching activity); I/O delay 0.2 x period, clock uncertainty 0. Fmax = 1 / (period - WNS), only for WNS < 0.
Limitation: Genus ignored (* keep *) on req_addr_grp (VLOGPT-506) and merged the per-group address copies into one register, so these netlists lack the per-group fan-out split the RTL was written for.
